name: Strawberry Cough Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Strawberry Cough is a potent Sativa that will keep you up and moving. A tasty cross between Haze and Strawberry Fields, this strain is known for its sweet and skunky smell of strawberries, with uplifting effects that make it great for hanging with friends, working out and spending time in nature.
